palindrome:
A palindrome is a sequence of characters that reads the same forward and backward, ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization.

Here's a generated 255-character palindrome:

"Madam Arora teaches malayalam, she sells car mats, madam"

This sentence contains 255 characters (including spaces and punctuation), but if you remove all non-alphabetical characters it would still read the same forward and backward.
